name: threesmith
description: three.js tools for Claude: the API of your installed three, a review pinned to it, asset checks, headless runs with screenshots, and 3D models.
long_description: Threesmith gives Claude checked three.js knowledge for your project: the API of the three version you have installed (read from node_modules, not from memory), a scored review that catches removed APIs, wrong import paths, black scenes, shadows that never draw, per-frame allocations and missing cleanup, and a headless Chromium check that opens your page with software WebGL, reports console errors and blank frames and returns a screenshot. Choose your project folder in the settings; tools also accept a path. The browser check needs playwright-core and Chromium in the project (npm i -D playwright-core).

project.title: three.js project
project.description: The folder with your package.json and node_modules/three. Tools use it when Claude does not pass a path.
